Luxio

Electric

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Luxio is an Electric-type Spark Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 30.5 kg. It evolves from Shinx and into Luxray. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 363.
